name: Scions of the Divine
source:
Many years ago, the world was graced with the presence of gods and goddesses that made living a mortal life easy and fun. However, that's not the case anymore, as a series of events has left the world without a divine presence for hundreds of years. With very few people being able to use magic, mortals turned to industrialization and technology to simulate the functions of the deities the best that they can.

Follow the story of a young man who's getting sick of how bland it can be inside of this modern industrial world ruled by a tyrant king when he suddenly receives divine power. With this change comes tough decisions, passionate romance, heartbreak, and so much more! Decide how these powers should be used and slowly change the world, for better or worse, but be wary; there are other Scions receiving divine power, each with their own ambitions!
